notes: Eight precut clips. Four are the loops; the stills come only from the other clips or from shots the loops leave out (the storefront and the spatula close-up in clip 6 sit outside loop-04), so nothing on the page repeats. The cover is a 2:5 column of the side street in clip 1 (sky behind the lettering), which only the rail shows.
